cnt=0
def solve(r,cols,d1,d2):
 global cnt
 if r==n:cnt+=1;return

  if c in cols or (r-c) in d1 or (r+c) in d2:continue

title: Dijkstra Shortest Distance
statement: Line1: N nodes M edges. Next M lines: a b w (undirected). Last line: s t. Print shortest weighted distance s->t or -1.
reference:
import heapq
from collections import defaultdict
n,m=map(int,input().split())
g=defaultdict(list)
for _ in range(m):
 a,b,w=map(int,input().split());g[a].append((b,w));g[b].append((a,w))
s,t=map(int,input().split())
dist={s:0};pq=[(0,s)]
while pq:
 d,u=heapq.heappop(pq)
 if u==t:break
 if d>dist.get(u,1e18):continue
 for v,w in g[u]:
  nd=d+w
  if nd<dist.get(v,1e18):dist[v]=nd;heapq.heappush(pq,(nd,v))
print(dist.get(t,-1))
